title: Bible Story: Moses and the Burning Bush
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Moses and the burning bush (Exodus 3:1-6) and names lessons: God speaks, respect holy places, obey God.

floor.question: What did Samuel say when he knew God was calling?
floor.answer: Speak, for your servant is listening

representations: a drawn bush with flames and green leaves
steps: Say why Moses removed his sandals.

board.do: Write: bush on fire, not burnt.

board.say: What did God tell Moses to do here?

board.do: Wait for the child to say take off his sandals.
Write: holy ground; lessons: respect, obey.

misconceptions.ask: What was strange about the burning bush?
misconceptions.repair: Read Exodus 3:2 and ask what is strange. Draw a bush with flames but green leaves.

misconceptions.ask: Why did God tell Moses to take off his sandals?
misconceptions.repair: Read Exodus 3:5. Talk about showing respect in a holy place.

misconceptions.ask: Whose flock was Moses looking after?
misconceptions.repair: Read Exodus 3:1 and draw sheep and goats.

misconceptions.ask: What did Moses answer when God called him?
misconceptions.repair: Read Exodus 3:4. Compare with Samuel's "Speak, for your servant is listening".

checks.question: What was strange about the bush?
checks.answer: It burnt but did not burn up

checks.question: Name a lesson from the story.
